thread:
taylor_sales: Acme asked for a compact teardown runbook we can send them tonight. Need owners and minimal commands.

mike_se: I'll own hosted keys + pool drain. Short plan: revoke keys, export logs 90d, drain pool, flush cache.

jess_ops: Ops will do VPC peering removal and snapshots. I will schedule teardown windows.

sophie_security: Quick check: legal hold? alex (sales) please confirm. If no, follow standard retention.

taylor_sales: Legal says no hold. Proceed.

mike_se: Hosted keys (owner: mike_se)
- Revoke tokens via Admin API and note in audit.
- Export request logs to s3://redwood-exports/acme/snapshot-<date>/logs
Example: curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/admin/keys/revoke -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" -d '{"key_id":"ak:acme:01","reason":"poc-teardown"}'

mike_se: Dedicated pool (owner: mike_se)
- Set pool to drain: redwoodctl pools drain --id pool-acme-01 --timeout 1200
- Wait up to 15m then scale to 0: redwoodctl pools scale --id pool-acme-01 --replicas 0
- Export metrics + cache snapshot to same S3 prefix.

jess_ops: VPC/private (owner: jess_ops)
- Confirm zero connections, delete peering: redwoodctl vpc peering delete --peering-id pcx-acme-01 --confirm
- Snapshot volumes if retention required, else schedule secure wipe.

sophie_security: Retention (owner: sophie_security)
- PII: delete within 7 days unless legal hold.
- Model I/O: retain 30 days by default, cold archive if requested, then delete.
- Produce deletion manifest with SHA256s and timestamps and upload to s3://redwood-exports/acme/manifests/.

taylor_sales: Can we schedule the final sweep after hours? Friday 23:00 UTC?

jess_ops: decomm-bot please schedule job acme-poc-final-sweep for 2026-04-16T23:00:00Z with steps: revoke-keys, export-logs, drain-pool, snapshot-or-wipe, flush-cache, delete-objects, upload-manifest.

decomm-bot: Job created: acme-poc-final-sweep (id: sweep-2026-04-16-114). Will post completion status here.

taylor_sales: Thanks team — I'll send this to the customer now.
